summary: Tested Rokad Panna v15 features end-to-end: (1) ALL-view per-account summary card with Opening/Jama/Kharch/Closing + TOTAL row; (2) default CASH IN HAND (code 301) auto-link on POST /api/rokad with empty cash_account_id; (3) Startup backfill left zero unlinked entries; (4) PUT /api/rokad/{id} edit flow with 404 on nonexistent; (5) Frontend edit modal (title 'Rokad Entry Edit', 'Update Entry' button, prefilled fields); (6) Clean 'Nayi Rokad Entry' form after editing with cash account still preselected. 9/9 backend pytest cases pass. Full Playwright flow passes (login → /rokad → create 9,08,400 jama (auto-linked to 301) → filter to 301 shows entry → edit to 5000/edited → reopen clean form → delete). DB restored to original 17 rokad entries.
critical_code_review_comments: RokadPanna.jsx is 707 lines — close to the 700-line threshold; consider extracting the modal form, allAccountsSummary card and bankSummary memo into separate components for maintainability.

Default-cash preselect effect (line 128) depends on `defaultCash` but the dependency array includes only [showAdd, accounts, bankFilter, defaultCash]; `form.cash_account_id` is read as early-return but not in deps. Current behaviour is correct but ESLint rule is intentionally disabled — add an inline comment explaining why.

PUT /api/rokad/{rid} re-applies default cash account fallback (good) and sets updated_at, but does NOT preserve the original created_at vs. the response (uses `{**existing, **doc}` so created_at is retained from existing — OK). Consider also persisting any voucher_no uniqueness checks — currently none.

The frontend accounts list is rebuilt from parties under group 'CASH & BANK BALANCE' + legacy accounts collection every mount; consider memoising / server-side `/cash-accounts` endpoint (already exists per line 615) for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Transient: one 9,08,400 jama entry created, edited to 5,000, then deleted. DB left with exactly 17 rokad entries (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rokad v15 (default cash link, PUT edit, backfill, all-accounts summary) is fully working. /app/backend/tests/test_rokad_v15.py is idempotent and safe to re-run. Admin creds unchanged.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in the three reported fixes. All three Rokad Panna changes verified working via UI + API.
